name: Portrait Of An Obsession
author: Addicting Games
description: Portrait Of An Obsession is a free escape room game. We are all obsessed and we are all trapped. All of us are prisoners of illusion in a world filled with the clues needed to unravel our lives and find our way to the truth. Portrait of aN obsession is a free desktop game that allows you the user to live out your wildest dreams as you try to unravel the secret of the house on the hill. Beware of the ghosts and ghouls that might pop up and even a murderer or two who is hiding in the shadows. There are a number of puzzles and riddles which you must collect the clues to solve and find your way out. it is a fun escape room and we're sure you'll love playing it as much as we loved publishing it.
